vectors.name: formats-yaml/nonfinite/nan-is-a-number
vectors.comment: C-17 and C-19: YAML spells it `.nan`. E-33 encodes the non-finite number as the string `NaN`. Verified live 2026-10-18 at the ports default-branch tips: passes on Python, TypeScript, Go, Java; fails on Rust (DIV-47, expected until adopted).

vectors.name: formats-yaml/nonfinite/bare-nan-is-a-string
vectors.comment: C-19: YAML spells NaN `.nan`; a plain `nan` is a string. Verified live 2026-10-18 at the ports default-branch tips: passes on Python, TypeScript, Rust, Go and Java.
